purpose: Network-capable zero-balance C01-C12 signer conformance execution contract
runner_startup: Abort if required scoped credential is absent.
Abort if credential value is present in argv, repository files, generated evidence, stdout or stderr.
Query balance and abort if any spendable balance is non-zero.
Load immutable founder payment policy: max A$25 equivalent per transaction and A$40 equivalent per day.
Restrict candidate execution to Base/native USDC and the exact benchmark resource/recipient under test.
Record policy/config hashes without recording secret values.
test_sequence: C04 wrong network or asset denial
C05 mutated payTo and resource binding denial
C06 expired or malformed challenge denial
C11 generic signing and arbitrary/direct transfer denial
pass_rule: A control may PASS only from machine-observed live candidate behavior. Documentation, mocks, synthetic responses or inferred behavior cannot PASS.
global_fail_rule: Any funds_moved=true, secret_exposure=true, non-zero starting balance, unbounded transfer/sign capability, unavailable policy state that does not fail closed, or missing evidence causes immediate FAIL and terminates the run.

post_run.checkout: DENY unless and until APPROVED_FOR_LIMITED_PILOT is independently recorded

truthfulness: This contract is execution scaffolding only. It is not evidence that ELTEX or C01-C12 has passed. No customer usage, payment, revenue or traction is implied.
